answers.core: Two built-in signals would be far more convenient than rebuilding with a module, and the plugin wouldn't solve the performance issue.
answers.workaround: It usually ends up being a dozen or some lines with the most minimal work around.  The issue though is mainly one of performance.  Having to examine and act on all these editor related nodes with each interaction in the editor.

title: Add `node_added` and `node_removed` signals to Node (in addition to the existing SceneTree signals)
